title: HTTP Status Codes You Must Know
intro: Every API response carries a status code. Knowing what they mean saves hours of debugging.

slides.heading: 2xx Success
slides.subtitle: The request worked as expected.
points: 201 Created — a new resource was made
204 No Content — success, nothing to return

slides.heading: 3xx Redirection
slides.subtitle: The resource moved somewhere else.
points: 304 Not Modified — use your cached copy

slides.heading: 4xx Client Error
slides.subtitle: The request itself was the problem.
points: 403 Forbidden — logged in, but not allowed
404 Not Found — the resource doesn't exist

slides.heading: 5xx Server Error
slides.subtitle: The request was fine, the server wasn't.

cta: Which status code do you see the most in your logs?
